title: Bimaru
desc: Find the hidden fleet. The numbers along the edge tell you how many cells of each row and column belong to a ship. Ships lie straight and never touch, not even diagonally.

status.play: Tap a cell: once for water, twice for a ship, three times to clear it. Tap a number to fill the rest of that line with water.
status.errors: {count} cells are wrong, they are outlined in red.
status.error_one: One cell is wrong, it is outlined in red.
status.no_hint: There is nothing left to reveal.
